node.statement: Let t=delta-C_pol*(epsilon_r*delta+delta^2). The root margin says 600*epsilon_r<t. By node 1.3 each X=U^dagger or U bold-dot V has a right inverse and defect at most 40*epsilon_r<2t (also strictly when epsilon_r=0 because t>0); hence X is in calU_t. Node 1.1 and lem-stage1-polar-retraction give calU_t subseteq S_delta.
